literal_meaning: অন্য কোনো পথ নেই (no other path)
similar_in_english: Between a rock and a hard place
example_sentences_in_bangla: এখন নান্যপন্থা, আমাদের এই কঠিন সিদ্ধান্তই নিতে হবে।
জীবনের এই মোড়ে নান্যপন্থা ছিল না, তাই সে চাকরি ছেড়ে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There's no other way now; we have to make this tough decision.
At that crossroads in life, there was no other way, so he quit his job.
history: Derived from the Vedic quote 'Nānyapanthā vidyatē'yanāya' from the scriptures, implying no alternative path to spiritual enlightenment or a goal.
note: This idiom originates from ancient Sanskrit Vedas and is used in Bengali to denote inevitability.
